pkgmetadata.longdescription:
WebSocket-to-PTY proxy used by pveproxy as the backend for xterm.js terminal sessions (host shell, container console). Written in Rust.
This package is the binary half of pve-xtermjs. The JS frontend is www-apps/pve-xtermjs. Both are required for working terminal consoles in the pxvirt web UI.
